item.title: Caker 1.0.3849
item.description:
Caker 1.0.3849

New version of Caker with improvements and bug fixes.

2026-10-24 (Git log summary - release)

  • feat: handle asif disk format and OS metadata for applevz Multipass imports
  • fix: use correct multipass setting key "local.driver"
  • Trim whitespace and newlines from stdout output
  • feat: support importing Multipass VMs using the applevz driver
  • feat: add `compose edit` to caked and cakectl
  • fix: rebuild the compose editor seed from the stored definition
  • fix: disable display refit for fixed-display Windows guests
  • docs: the French Windows ISO was checked
  • docs: any Windows language can be installed (the image's language is used)
  • feat: fixed-display Windows guests hide the display size picker and always use 1024x768
  • feat: caked vnc, cakectl vnc and Caker's VNC view keep a stock-driver Windows window fixed
  • feat: the VM window of a Windows guest with the stock display driver is not resizable
  • feat: WINDOWS_WHQL_ONLY provisioning variable and wizard toggle (no sound, no display resizing)
  • feat: list Windows guests as unavailable in the sandboxed (App Store) build
  • feat: install or update the agent in a Windows guest (VMLocation.installAgent)
  • chore: bump CAKEAGENT_SNAPSHOT to e0dbef5c (one display for a Windows guest)
  • feat: WINDOWS_AUTOLOGON provisioning variable and wizard toggle for Windows guests
  • fix: keep a Windows guest's display width a multiple of 4 in the VM view
  • fix: run the Windows agent without async preemption on every x64 guest
  • fix: set testIgnoreEntitlementChecks right before validate()
  • fix: call the explicit setter for _testIgnoreEntitlementChecks
  • docs: list the Windows provisioning variables in the command summary
  • feat: install a sound driver in Windows guests
  • fix: send guest audio to the host's output device
  • feat: choose the Windows display buffer size (16-256 MB) in the wizard
  • feat: carry windowsFrameSegmentMiB through the VirtualMachineConfiguration protocol and gRPC
  • chore: bump CAKEAGENT_SNAPSHOT to 4dbfdb00 (retry and fallback for a refused display size)
  • feat: ship the 32 MiB frame segment build of the Windows GPU driver
  • fix: keep a Windows guest's display inside what its driver can hold
  • feat: bypass VM entitlement checks in unsigned debug builds
  • chore: make WindowsInstaller.doInstall internal
  • feat: let the VM wizard collect and validate the Windows product key
  • feat: use the WINDOWS_KEY provisioning variable as the Windows product key
  • fix: Windows Server agent start: retry for 5 minutes, no asyncpreemption on 2022, agent wait with deadlines
  • chore: bump CAKEAGENT_SNAPSHOT to c82445b8 (display following in the agent)
  • feat: let cakeagent follow the display size instead of a PowerShell script
  • fix: post WinPETerminatedNotification when the Windows installer stops
  • fix: widen the VM wizard window to fit the Windows options
  • fix: shut a Windows guest down through its agent instead of requestStop
  • fix: start cakeagent 15 s after boot on Windows Server, retrying until it runs
  • feat: add a keyboard shortcut to toggle the host cursor in the VM view
  • docs: document Windows support and that the ISO name must contain windows
  • docs: record the x64 GPU driver result and update the Windows docs
  • feat: ship caker's patched virtio GPU driver for x64 guests too
  • chore: ship the opt-in build of the Windows GPU driver
  • chore: rebuild the Windows GPU driver from the reviewed upstream change
  • feat: make Windows ARM64 guests follow the host's display size again
  • revert: stop special-casing Windows guests for window and display sizing
  • feat: install a patched virtio GPU driver in Windows ARM64 guests
  • feat: give the window of a Windows guest a fixed size
  • fix: don't resize the screen or window of a Windows guest
  • fix: stop following host resizes in Windows guests, and fix the agent marker check
  • feat: split Windows install completion from the first-boot setup step
  • fix: make Windows guests follow VZVirtualMachineView resizes
  • fix: patch graphics outputs in place instead of replacing the GOP in the Windows framebuffer driver
  • feat: install and start the OpenSSH server in Windows guests
  • feat: report Windows install progress via substep/provisioned handlers
  • feat: widen ISO field and bump disk size for Windows images
  • chore: use cakeagent snapshot 2fb8030a (Windows vsock listener, service support, Execute)
  • fix: use NVMe for Windows block-device attachments
  • feat: build the Windows EFI helpers for x64 and pick them by guest architecture
  • feat: make the Windows installer architecture-neutral (arm64/amd64 guests)
  • feat: install cakeagent in Windows guests, listening on vsock with the agent certificates
  • feat: install the virtio-vsock (viosock) driver in Windows guests
  • feat: include viostor and viorng drivers from the virtio-win ISO
  • feat: disable Windows 11 ISO installation in the App Store build
  • feat: load the GPU driver in WinPE and install WinFsp + virtio-fs for shared folders
  • test: follow the Windows installer refactor (static computerName, os == .windows root disk)
  • fix: register the WIM sources in the Xcode projects; log install progress in WinPE
  • feat: edit WinPE's boot.wim in Swift instead of with wimlib
  • feat: show live Windows install progress and support cancellation
  • feat: add Windows as a first-class VirtualizedOS across the gRPC API
  • feat: add human-readable description for VZVirtualMachine.State
  • feat: install Windows 11 for ARM unattended on Virtualization.framework
  • wip: Windows boot helpers (UEFI framebuffer driver, loader) and CPU features
  • revert: restore the English-only Windows 11 PackerLite template
  • feat: French Windows 11 ISO support in the PackerLite template
  • feat: Windows 11 ISO install via PackerLite with LabConfig TPM/Secure Boot bypass
